questions.question: If sqrt x + (1)/(sqrt x) = sqrt 6 then the value of x⁶ + (1)/(x⁶) will be
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**x + 1/x = n ⇒ x² + 1/x² = n² - 2 and x³ + 1/x³ = n³ - 3n

Now,

√x + 1/√x = √6

⇒ x + 1/x = (√6)² - 2 = 4

⇒ x² + 1/x² = 4² - 2 = 14

Now,

x⁶ + 1/x⁶ = 14³ - 3 × 14

⇒ 2744 - 42 = 2702

**Traditional method:**

**Given:**

√ x + (1)/(√ x) = √ 6

**Formula:**

(a + b)² = a² + b² + 2ab

(a + b)³ = a³ + b³ + 3ab(a + b)

**Calculation:**

√ x + (1)/(√ x) = √ 6

⇒ (√x + 1/√x)² = 6

⇒ x + 1/x + 2 = 6

⇒ (x + 1/x) = 4

⇒ x² + 1/x² = 4² - 2 = 14

⇒ (x² + 1/x²)³ = x⁶ + 1/x⁶ + 3(x² + 1/x²)

**∴ (x⁶ + 1/x⁶) = 2702**

questions.question: An article was sold for Rs. 512 after giving two equal successive discounts on the marked price of Rs. 800. The percentage discount offered is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

SP = Rs.512

MP = Rs.800

**Calculation:**

⇒ 512 = 800 × (100 - ? /100)

⇒ ? = 36%

Single discount = 36%

Let two equal discounts be a%.

⇒ 36 = (a + a - a²/100)

⇒ a² - 200a + 3600 = 0

⇒ a² - 180a - 20a + 3600 = 0

⇒ a(a - 180) - 20(a - 180) = 0

a = 180% or a = 20%

questions.question: In triangle ABC, if BD and CD bisect ∠B and ∠C , respectively, and ∠BDC = 135°, then find the measure of ∠BAC .

[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**D is the incenter.

∠D = ∠BAC/2 + 90

⇒ 135° = ∠BAC/2 + 90

⇒ ∠BAC/2 = 45° 

⇒ ∠BAC = 90° 

**∴ The required angle is 90°.**

**Given:**

∠BAC = 135°

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d67bb4a2fb5b6514d51c7627a0a72018fa2c5532a8c592e141d80db7c4cc97ac.png]

In ΔBDC,

⇒ ∠BDC + ∠DBC + ∠DCB = 180°

⇒ ∠DBC + ∠DCB = 180° - 135° = 45°

⇒ ∠ABC/2 + ∠ACB/2 = 45°

⇒ ∠ABC + ∠ACB = 90°

In ΔABC,

⇒ ∠ABC + ∠ACB + ∠BAC = 180°

⇒ ∠BAC = 180° - 90° = 90°

questions.question: If cosec θ = (41)/(9) and θ is an acute angle, then the value of 5 tan θ will be:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**Exam approach - 

41, 9 and 40 make a triplet.

Given that cosecθ = 41/9. It means Hypotenuse = 41 and Perpendicular = 9. Therefore, base = 40

tanθ = Perpendicular/Base

⇒ tan θ = 9/40

⇒ 5tan θ = 5 × (9/40) = 9/8

**∴ The required value is 9/8.**

**Traditional method:**

**Given:**

cosec θ = (41)/(9) 

**Formula:**

sin²θ + cos²θ = 1

**Calculation:**

sin θ = 9/41

cos θ = √(1 - (9/41)²) = 40/41

tan θ = (sinθ)/(cosθ) = (9/41) × (41/40) = 9/40

**∴ 5 tanθ = 5 × 9/40 = 9/8**

questions.question: Varun and Madhur invested Rs. 25,000 each in different schemes. Varun earned simple interest at 11% per annum, whereas Madhur earned compound interest at 10% per annum compounded annually. Who received more interest after 2 years and how much?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Rate of interest = 11%

**Formula:**

Let P = Principal, R = rate of interest and N = time

Simple interest = PNR/100

Compound interest = P(1 + R/100)ⁿ - P

**Calculation:**

SI earned by Varun = (25000 × 2 × 11)/100 = Rs.5500

Equivalent rate of interest for Madhur = 10 + 10 + (10 × 10)/100 = 21%

Compound interest for Madhur = 21% of 25000 = (25000 × 21)/100

⇒ Rs. 5250

Difference between interests = 5500 - 5250 = Rs.250

**∴ Varun earned Rs.250 more interest than Madhur.**

questions.question: A train starts running at a uniform speed of 60 km/h from station P towards station Q. At the same time another train starts running from station Q towards station P. If the distance between the stations P and Q is 275 km and the trains meet in two and a half hours, then what is the speed of the train running towards station P in km/h?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Let the speed of both train be P and Q.

Meeting time = Distance/(P + Q)

⇒ 2.5 = 275/(60 + Q)

⇒ 150 + 2.5Q = 275

⇒ 2.5Q = 125

⇒ Q = 50 km/h

**∴ The speed of Q is 50 km/h.**

**Traditional method:**

**Given:**

Distance between P and Q = 275km

**Calculation:**

Let speed of train running towards station P be a kmph.

Relative speed = a + 60

Then,

⇒ a + 60 = 275/2.5

⇒ a + 60 = 110

⇒ a = 50

**∴ speed of train running towards station P is 50 kmph.**

questions.question: The volume of a metallic cylindrical pipe is 3564 cm³. If its external radius is 12 cm and thickness is 3 cm, then the length of the pipe will be: (take π = 22/7)
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Volume of cylindrical pipe = 3564 cubic.cm

**Formula:**

Volume of cylinder = πr²h

**Calculation:**

Internal radius = 12 - 3 = 9 cm

Then,

⇒ 3564 = 22/7 × (12² - 9²) × h

⇒ h = 18

**∴ Length of pipe is 18cm**

questions.question: The average daily income of Shyam Lal during the month of February 2020 was Rs. 560. The average income for the first 16 days was Rs. 590 and for the last 16 days it was Rs. 500. What was his average income for 14th 15th and 16th February?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Average daily income for February month = Rs.560

**Calculation:**

2020 is a leap year, so number of days in February is 29.

Total daily income of Shyam lal = 29 × 560 = Rs.16240

Total daily income for first 16 days = 16 × 590 = Rs.9440

Total daily income for last 16 days = 16 × 500 = Rs.8000

Total income for 14th, 15th and 16th days = 17440 - 16240 = Rs.1200

**∴ His average income for 14th 15th and 16th February = 1200/3 = Rs.400**

questions.question: ABC is a right-angled triangle, right-angled at B. D is a point on AC such that AD = 12 cm and CD = 16 cm. If BD bisects ∠ABC , then the perimeter of ΔABC will be:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

AD = 12 cm and CD = 16 cm

**Calculation:**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/50b6807e9e4d1d2ef685dc9e0ced84523b4d15588b2111ef209e0ce17a9ee64d.png] **

BD is angle bisector of ∠ABC.

⇒ AD/CD = AB/BC

⇒ AB/BC = 12/16 = 3/4

Let AB and BC be 3a and 4a respectively.

Using pythagoras theorem,

⇒ AC² = AB² + BC²

⇒ AC = 5a

⇒ AD + DC = AC

⇒ AC = 12 + 16 = 28

⇒ 28 = 5a

⇒ a = 5.6

**∴ Perimeter of ΔABC = 3a + 4a + 5a = 12a = 67.2 cm**

questions.question: A shopkeeper bought pens at the rate of Rs. 1,350 for 15 dozen pens and sold them at the rate of Rs. 495 for 5 dozen pens. His percentage profit or percentage loss is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Cost price of 15 dozen pens = Rs.1350

**Formula:**

Profit % = (SP - CP)/CP × 100

**Calculation:**

Cost price of a pen = 1350/(15 × 12) = Rs.7.5

Selling price of a pen = 495/(5 × 12) = Rs.8.25

**∴ Profit % = (8.25 - 7.5)/7.5 × 100 = 10%**

questions.question: If a number 54k31m82 is divisible by 11, what will be the maximum value of (k + m) ?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Number = 54k31m82

**Concept:**

Divisibility test of 11 = If the difference of the sum of alternative digits of a number is divisible by 11, then that number is divisible by 11 completely.

**Calculation:**

⇒ (5 + k + 1 + 8) - (4 + 3 + m + 2) = (14 + k - 9 - m) = k - m + 5

⇒ k - m = -5

take maximum value of m = 9

⇒ k = -5 + 9 = 4

**∴ m + k = 4 + 9 = 13**

questions.question: If x - (2)/(x) = 4 then what will be the value of x² + (4)/(x²) ?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

x - (2)/(x) = 4

**Formula:**

(a - b)² = a² + b² - 2ab

**Calculation:**

**x - (2)/(x) = 4**

Squaring both sides, we get:

(x - (2)/(x))² = 16

**∴ (x² + 4/x²) - 2 (x)(2/x) = 16**

x2 + 4/x2** - 4 = 16**

x2 + 4/x2 = 20

∠APB = 42°

∠ A + ∠ B = 180 (Due to the tangent made and touch radius)
